summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital Ltd furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a routine board appointment. The Fidelis Partnership, exercising Bye-Law 54.3(a)(iv) designation rights, named Michael Davern to succeed Charles Mathias, who resigned effective August 2, 2026. On September 14, 2026, the Nominations and Corporate Governance Committee appointed Davern as a Class I director serving until the 2027 annual general meeting, plus Risk and Investment Committee seats. Davern, Pine Walk Capital CEO and Fidelis UK Chief Underwriting Officer, receives standard non-executive compensation paid directly to Fidelis. No deal terms, stake changes, or special-situation mechanics apply; watch only governance and related-party oversight.
